items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Yeah, Buddy played with us a long time.

ctx.x: Can you tell us anything about the different trumpet players you worked with, like Buddy Petit? I never got to hear him. What style he played? Could you give any idea what he played like or any other... He was a nice...
He was a nice trumpet player, Buddy was a nice... In other words he had a different tone I think than any of those trumpet players.
He wasn't too much of a loud trumpet player but he had a sweet tone. I mean, he wasn't those blasted, you know what I mean, blasted trumpet.
